english.title: Fail to comply with requirement to surrender passport under Modern Slavery Act 2015
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement to surrender all of your passports at **(..SPECIFY POLICE STATION..) contained in a

(A)_[slavery and trafficking prevention order]_
(B)_[slavery and trafficking risk order]_

made on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) by **(..SPECIFY COURT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30(2)(a) and 30(3) of the Modern Slavery Act 2015.
